name: maturity_min_pairs
label_en: (key, day) pairs seen at an early age and at the final age that a fit needs before it counts
label_zh: 一条拟合所需的（键、日）配对数
explain: below it the curve is the prior and says prior_only; the standard error of the fit is not trusted with fewer
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_min_ages
label_en: distinct early ages among the pairs that a fit needs before it counts
label_zh: 一条拟合所需的不同早期日龄数
explain: one age says how much is visible then, not how it grows
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_immature_share
label_en: a window whose visible share of its final number is under this is immature
label_zh: 窗口可见占最终数的比例低于此值即算未成熟
explain: an immature window whose interval straddles a threshold gives no verdict
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_refit_days
label_en: days after which a fitted curve is stale and the pack should refit it
label_zh: 曲线过了多少天就算过期、应重新拟合
explain: the lag can change; a weekly refit is the draft cadence, and the pack decides it
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_drift_se
label_en: how many standard errors a curve's parameter may move between two fits before it is said to have drifted
label_zh: 两次拟合之间参数移动多少个标准误就算漂移
explain: 3 is rare by chance and visible when the lag really changes
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_interval_z
label_en: the width of the interval in standard errors; 1.645 is a 90 % interval
label_zh: 区间宽度（标准误数）；1.645 为 90% 区间
explain: a prediction interval for the final number
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_prior_sd_share
label_en: how far a cold-start tau may be from the truth, as a share of itself: the prior's standard deviation
label_zh: 冷启动 tau 可偏离真值多少（占其自身的比例）
explain: wide on purpose: a prior is a guess, and the data should move it
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_family_gain
label_en: how much better, on keys held out, a Weibull must fit than the exponential to be kept
label_zh: 保留 Weibull 所需比指数形式在留出的键上好多少
explain: the exponential has one parameter fewer; keep it unless the shape pays
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_prior_tau_1
label_en: the cold-start tau of a 1-day attribution window
label_zh: 1 天归因窗口的冷启动 tau
explain: orders arrive mostly on the day: F(0) near 0.63
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_prior_tau_7
label_en: the cold-start tau of a 7-day attribution window
label_zh: 7 天归因窗口的冷启动 tau
explain: about half of a day's final orders are visible on the day itself: F(0) near 0.49
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client

name: maturity_prior_tau_28
label_en: the cold-start tau of a 28-day attribution window
label_zh: 28 天归因窗口的冷启动 tau
explain: a longer window keeps collecting orders for weeks
why: a draft until a person confirms it for a client
